cases.title: Internal tools API lists open_start_run
steps: Build and start graph-manager with temp dirs as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes
Clone or create a workspace under $GM_DIR/ws/github/octo/hello with committed diamond/ and spec.md fixtures
Open a plain terminal in that workspace (POST /api/terminals {workspaceId}) and in it run: curl -s -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN" $GM_INTERNAL_URL/api/internal/tools
cases.expected: The JSON lists open_start_run with an inputSchema whose required contains tasksDir and spec; the same curl without the header returns 401

cases.title: MCP command round trip
steps: In a graph-manager terminal in the workspace, run: printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18"}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | graph-manager-mcp
Run the same outside a graph-manager terminal (no GM_* env): node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/mcp.js
cases.expected: Inside: two responses, serverInfo.name graph-manager and a tools list containing open_start_run. Outside: tools is []

cases.title: open_start_run queues a request and the popup opens next to the terminal
steps: Log in to the UI, open Terminals, open a plain terminal in the workspace and keep it visible

In it call the tool: curl -s -X POST -H "authorization: Bearer $GM_INTERNAL_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d "{\"terminalId\":\"$GM_TERMINAL_ID\",\"cwd\":\"$PWD\",\"input\":{\"tasksDir\":\"diamond\",\"spec\":\"spec.md\"}}" $GM_INTERNAL_URL/api/internal/tools/open_start_run
cases.expected: The curl prints text starting 'Opened the Start run form'; the Start run drawer opens on the Terminals page with Tasks folder 'diamond' and Spec 'spec.md'; GET /api/agent-requests is then empty

cases.title: Toast on another page and Open
steps: With the UI on the Runs page, repeat the P3 curl from the terminal (via the API: POST /api/terminals/<id> input is not available, so run curl in a terminal opened earlier, then switch to Runs)
cases.expected: A toast '<Agent or An agent> in hello wants to start a run' appears with Open; clicking Open shows the prefilled Start run drawer; Start run with provider fake starts a run

cases.title: Tool errors
steps: Call open_start_run as in P3 with spec 'nope.md'
Call it from a terminal opened at the workspaces root (POST /api/terminals {})
cases.expected: Both return isError true, with 'spec nope.md is not a file inside the workspace' and 'this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace'; GET /api/agent-requests stays empty

cases.title: Agent buttons and Claude launch
steps: Open Terminals in the UI (agent-browser) at desktop width and at 390 px
Click Claude Code, pick the workspace, Create
cases.expected: GET /api/agents lists claude, codex, opencode, qwen with installed flags matching the PATH; the four buttons and Plain terminal show, missing CLIs disabled with '<binary> is not installed'; the button shows 'Connecting tools…' then a pane opens titled 'Claude Code · hello' where the shell has run claude --mcp-config <dataDir>/agents/claude-mcp.json --allowedTools mcp__graph-manager

cases.title: Qwen Code commits its project config once
steps: Put a fake executable 'qwen' (a sh script that prints its args) on the server's PATH before starting graph-manager
Edit .qwen/settings.json without committing and POST again
cases.expected: First POST 201 with connected.changed true and git log -1 --format=%s 'chore: connect graph-manager tools for Qwen Code' touching only .qwen/settings.json; second POST adds no commit; third returns 409 'cannot commit .qwen/settings.json: it has uncommitted changes' and no terminal is created

cases.title: Quitting the agent leaves a shell
steps: Open an agent terminal whose fake CLI exits immediately
cases.expected: The terminal's status is idle or working, not exited, and typing in it reaches the shell
